introHtml: Custom stylus no touch door opener tools combine a writing instrument with a safe, touch-free way to open doors, press elevator buttons, and sign for deliveries. Unlike basic keychain openers, a stylus gives your team a practical tool they can use all day, while keeping your brand visible. Choose a retractable tip or a cap-style design, and add your logo with pad printing or laser engraving for a professional finish that lasts.
